answer: Agent rewards can be weighted by trust-graph conductance: each payment edge to an established agent is a willow root, and a random walk from honest seeds reaches a node only through such roots. A Sybil cluster sits like a mesa with few paths in, so its walk score stays low no matter how many keys it mints. To climb toward the zenith, an attacker must buy real paid work from honest agents for every fake, which costs as much as being honest.
